title: RAW UNREVIEWED: heliotropium keeps distinct traced-circle, carried-plant and rooted-knot participants
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED. Complete PlinyXXII.29 differentiates a sprig tracing a ground-circle around a scorpion, a plant carried three times around a fever patient then placed under the head, and a patient tying disease-conditioned knots in a plant left in the ground while praying to recover and untie them. Keep the whole two-kind entry, solar introduction, organ changes and attributions. These are different directed participant/continuation contracts, not interchangeable counts, celestial nouns or confirmed Voynich readings.

whole_source.locator: BOOK_XXII_CHAP_29 through immediately before BOOK_XXII_CHAP_30; all notes2596–2612; printed413–415
whole_source.layer: Pliny Natural History XXII.29 in Bostock/Riley English translation, volumeIV, London HenryG.Bohn1856, pp413–415; Gutenberg61113 electronic reproduction. Not a fresh Latin or medieval manuscript collation.

design.content_hypothesis: A medical-botanical account can preserve one named plant family while changing the plant from a naturally sun-oriented organism to a tool or material in explicitly different operations on animals and patients. The entire source constrains those role changes; it does not equate astronomical motion, traced enclosure, bodily carrying and knotting.

whole_entry_constraints: The opening general heliotropium follows the Sun even in cloudy weather and closes its blue flower at night. This is not explicitly distributed over both later kinds; no modern photosensitivity or circadian mechanism is supplied.

H=helioscopium is taller, branches from the root, has harvest-time seed in follicles and prefers rich cultivated soil. T=tricoccum/scorpiuron grows everywhere, with smaller downward leaves and seed resembling a scorpion tail. H and T remain distinct historical kinds, not modern taxa or reproductive sexes.

For H, summer and sixth-hour juice collection precedes mixing with wine for keeping; rose-oil, salt, milk, hydromel, cumin and other applications retain their separate preparation and recipient roles. The time of juice collection is not automatically a time for knotting or carrying.
Both kinds receive a wart-removal claim. Shared claimed effect does not collapse kinds, materials, preparations or individual portions.

Editorial notes2596–2612 are all retained. In particular modern species identifications, disputed follicles/height/blue flower and a commentator flower-cluster comparison remain separate from the source main text seed-tail claim.
actual_extra_relational_consequences: The scorpion-circle result concerns the animal remaining relative to a drawn ground mark. The patient-circuit ends with the moving plant under a head. A reading that treats both circles as the plant remaining around its recipient loses an explicit later placement and changes the referent of the boundary.

The Magi branch preserves a grounded plant and a patient agent across knotting and intended untying. The carrying branch changes the plant location; the knot branch explicitly retains it. The same default TAKE/EXTRACT/WEAR operation cannot express both unchanged.

Four/three selects seed and knot counts by fever category, while three circumambulations is separately written. A single global numeral-to-period or count permutation cannot erase the operation owning each count.

Knotting is prescribed, recovery and untying are hoped for. Replacing the prayer with an achieved therapeutic state adds a truth commitment not present in this source; the known goal-versus-execution distinction is reused, not newly discovered.

rivals.name: one portable amulet action for every plant use
rivals.difference: Imports extraction/wearing into the last rooted-plant rule and cannot preserve its location condition.

rivals.name: one completed circular motion for every around expression
rivals.difference: Conflates a traced circle retaining a scorpion, a moved plant later placed under a head, and generic solar orientation. None is merely a renamed period.

rivals.name: all numbers are one fever-period parameter
rivals.difference: Silently changes the expressly three carrying circuits, or fails to distinguish counted seed grains from counted knots.

rivals.name: untying cures the patient as an executed event
rivals.difference: Reverses or strengthens the prayer to recover so as to untie, and asserts two events the source does not report.
